mergedParams.userDescription: Brush stroke paint smear swipe mask transition effects between videos

output.title: Brush Stroke Paint Smear Video Transitions

prompts.prompt: Create a brush stroke paint transition preset where videos transition through animated SVG brush stroke masks that sweep across the screen horizontally. The outgoing video should be revealed through a painted brush stroke mask that expands from left to right, while the incoming video appears behind it with a complementary brush stroke reveal. Use a 1.5 second overlap period where both videos are visible through their respective paint masks. The brush strokes should have organic, hand-painted qualities with slightly irregular edges and varying opacity along the stroke path. Configure the BaseLayout container to hold both VideoAtom elements with absolute positioning, where the outgoing video uses a custom SVG mask filter that animates its reveal property, and the incoming video has a higher z-index with its own animated mask. The transition should feel like an artist painting one scene over another with bold, expressive strokes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 1.5s overlap. Two VideoAtom elements positioned absolutely with 'absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover'. Outgoing video starts at 0s with mask-image SVG animation using CSS custom properties for the brush stroke path. Incoming video starts at (video1.duration - 1.5s) with z-10 layering. Use generic effects in provider mode: outgoing video gets a transform translateX animation from 0 to 100% during overlap, incoming video gets mask-size animation from 0% to 100% width. SVG masks defined in defs with feGaussianBlur for soft edges. Tailwind classes: 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' for container, custom CSS for mask-image and mask-composite properties.

prompts.prompt: Design a vertical paint smear wipe transition where videos blend through multiple parallel brush strokes that cascade down the screen like dripping paint. Create 5-7 vertical brush stroke columns that reveal the incoming video with staggered timing, each column having a unique brush texture and slightly different animation speed. The outgoing video should dissolve through these paint drips with a wet paint blending effect. Use a 2-second overlap where the paint strokes progressively reveal more of the incoming video while the outgoing video's opacity decreases in the exposed areas. Each brush column should have subtle movement variation to simulate natural paint flow, with some columns moving faster than others.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with calculated duration and 'relative w-full h-full bg-black' container. Outgoing VideoAtom at full duration, incoming VideoAtom starting at (video1.duration - 2s). Create 7 divs as mask layers with 'absolute top-0 h-full w-[14.28%]' positioned at different left percentages. Each mask div contains a semi-transparent gradient background simulating brush texture. Use generic effects targeting each mask div with staggered translateY animations from -100% to 100%, delays from 0ms to 400ms. Apply mix-blend-mode: multiply to outgoing video, mix-blend-mode: screen to incoming video. Include filter effects for both videos: outgoing gets increasing blur (0px to 4px), incoming gets decreasing blur (4px to 0px) during overlap.

prompts.prompt: Build a circular paint splash transition that radiates outward from the center like a paint drop hitting water. The transition should start with a small paint blob in the center that rapidly expands with organic, irregular edges, revealing the incoming video underneath. Add secondary splatter effects around the main splash with smaller paint droplets that appear at random positions. The outgoing video should appear to be 'painted over' with visible brush texture in the transition area. Include a subtle shake effect during the initial impact moment (first 200ms of the 1.8s overlap) to emphasize the paint splash energy. The edges of the paint splash should have varying opacity to create a natural, hand-painted look.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with overflow-hidden and relative positioning. Place outgoing VideoAtom from 0s to full duration, incoming VideoAtom from (video1.duration - 1.8s). Create a radial gradient mask using CSS custom properties on the outgoing video that animates from 0% to 150% size from center point. Add 8-10 absolutely positioned divs for splatter elements with 'rounded-full bg-white opacity-80' at random positions, each with scale animations from 0 to 1 with varied timing. Apply shake effect using generic transform effect with translateX/Y rapid oscillation for 200ms on the entire BaseLayout. Use clip-path with circle() function animating from 0% to 100% on incoming video. Include blur filter animation on transition edges from 8px to 0px.

prompts.prompt: Develop a diagonal paint swipe transition where a thick brush stroke sweeps across from top-left to bottom-right corner with realistic paint texture and depth. The brush stroke should have multiple layers - a main opaque stroke with semi-transparent edges that create a feathered effect. As the paint swipe moves across, it should reveal the incoming video while simultaneously pushing the outgoing video off-screen with a subtle 3D rotation effect. Add paint drip details along the edge of the swipe that move at slightly different speeds. The overlap period of 1.6 seconds should show the paint building up thickness before sweeping across.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden perspective-1000' for 3D space. Outgoing VideoAtom with rotateY transform animation from 0deg to -25deg and translateX from 0 to -30% during overlap. Incoming VideoAtom with initial rotateY at 25deg animating to 0deg, translateX from 30% to 0. Create diagonal mask using linear-gradient at 45deg angle, animating gradient stops from [-100%, -90%] to [100%, 110%]. Add 3 divs for paint drips with 'absolute w-2 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/80 to-transparent' positioned along the diagonal, each with unique translateY animation. Apply drop-shadow filter to the brush stroke edge div. Use z-index layering: outgoing=1, brush stroke=5, incoming=3.

prompts.prompt: Create an ink wash dissolve transition where videos blend through flowing watercolor paint effects that spread organically across the frame. The transition should simulate wet-on-wet watercolor technique with colors bleeding and merging at the boundaries. Start with small ink drops at multiple random points that expand and merge together, creating unpredictable organic shapes. The outgoing video should appear to be washed away by the spreading ink, while the incoming video emerges through the translucent paint layers. Include subtle color shifts in the transition area to simulate paint mixing. Use a longer 2.5-second overlap to show the gradual paint flow.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with duration calculation for 2.5s overlap. Position both VideoAtoms absolutely with full coverage. Create 6 divs as ink drop origins at random positions using 'absolute rounded-full' with radial gradients. Each div animates scale from 0 to random values between 20-40 using transform scale3d for GPU acceleration. Apply mix-blend-mode: color-burn to ink drops, mix-blend-mode: lighten to incoming video during overlap. Use CSS filters on outgoing video: contrast animation from 100% to 150%, saturate from 100% to 0%. Incoming video gets contrast from 50% to 100%. Add turbulence filter using SVG feTurbulence for organic edge distortion. Stagger animation starts by 100-300ms for natural flow.

prompts.prompt: Design a paint roller transition that simulates a paint roller moving vertically down the screen in multiple passes, each pass revealing more of the incoming video. The roller should leave visible paint texture with slight transparency variations showing the roller's pressure differences. Create 3 roller passes at different horizontal positions with slightly overlapping coverage. Each pass should have a subtle bounce effect at the start and end to simulate the roller lifting and pressing. The outgoing video should show paint streak artifacts where the roller has passed. Include paint splatter particles that fly off the roller during movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2-second overlap period and 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-100' container. Create 3 divs for roller passes with 'absolute w-1/3 h-full' at left-0, left-1/3, and left-2/3. Each roller div contains a gradient background simulating paint texture with repeating linear-gradient for roller marks. Animate each roller div with translateY from -100% to 100% with staggered start times (0ms, 200ms, 400ms). Add cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) easing for bounce effect. Create 12 particle divs with 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-white' that animate with random trajectories using transform translate and rotate. Apply backdrop-filter: blur(2px) to roller divs. Use z-index: outgoing=1, rollers=10, incoming=5, particles=15.

prompts.prompt: Build a spiraling paint vortex transition where both videos swirl into each other through a painted whirlpool effect. The spiral should start from the outer edges and twist inward, with the outgoing video spiraling out while the incoming video spirals in from the center. Add paint streak trails that follow the spiral path with varying thickness and opacity. The vortex should have 3-4 visible arms that rotate at different speeds to create a dynamic, layered effect. Include a subtle zoom effect during the spiral to enhance the sense of depth and movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' and 1.8s overlap. Apply transform-style: preserve-3d to container. Outgoing VideoAtom with animation: rotate from 0deg to 720deg, scale from 1 to 0.1, spiral path using offset-path with SVG path data. Incoming VideoAtom with reverse animation: rotate from -720deg to 0deg, scale from 2 to 1. Create 4 spiral arm divs using clip-path: polygon() with spiral coordinates, each with different rotation speeds (360deg, 540deg, 720deg, 900deg). Add CSS custom properties for spiral path calculation. Apply filter: blur() animation from 0px to 6px on outgoing, 6px to 0px on incoming. Use transform-origin: center center for all rotations. Include opacity fade from 1 to 0 on outgoing, 0 to 1 on incoming during last 500ms.

prompts.prompt: Develop a paint splatter burst transition where the screen appears to be hit by multiple paint balls that explode and reveal the incoming video. Create 4-6 impact points at strategic positions with different timing, each splatter expanding with realistic physics - fast initial expansion then slower spread. The paint should have visible thickness with shadows and highlights. As splatters overlap, they should merge naturally with proper blending. The outgoing video should crack and peel away like dried paint being broken by the impacts. Add small paint droplets that fly outward from each impact point.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2.2s overlap and 'relative w-full h-full overflow-visible' for particles. Create 5 impact divs with 'absolute rounded-full' at different positions. Each impact has nested structure: outer splatter div with scale animation from 0 to random 3-5x, inner highlight div with gradient for depth. Stagger impacts by 150ms intervals. Outgoing VideoAtom gets clip-path animation using polygon points that create crack patterns expanding from impact centers. Add transform: scale3d() with slight z-axis movement for depth. Create 30 droplet divs with 'absolute w-0.5 h-0.5 rounded-full' that animate along parabolic paths using cubic-bezier timing. Apply box-shadow to splatter divs for thickness effect. Use mix-blend-mode: multiply for paint overlay effect.

prompts.prompt: Create a horizontally sliding paint curtain transition with multiple paint strips that slide across like vertical blinds covered in wet paint. Each strip should have dripping paint effects at the bottom edge that continue to flow during the transition. Design 8-10 vertical strips that slide at different speeds and directions (some left, some right) to create a complex reveal pattern. The strips should have varying paint thickness and transparency, with some areas showing paint runs and drips. As strips slide away, they should leave subtle paint residue trails on the outgoing video. Include a slight rotation on each strip to add dimensional depth.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1.7s overlap and 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden preserve-3d' for 3D transforms. Create 10 divs for paint strips with 'absolute h-full w-[10%]' positioned at 10% intervals. Each strip has background with linear-gradient simulating paint thickness and opacity variations. Alternate strips animate translateX to -100% (odd) and 100% (even) with varied duration (1.2s to 1.7s). Add rotateY from 0deg to 15deg (odd) and -15deg (even) for depth. Create drip child divs within each strip using 'absolute bottom-0 w-full h-20' with animated translateY for continuous dripping. Apply backdrop-filter: blur(3px) to strips. Use CSS paint trails with ::after pseudo-elements that fade opacity from 0.3 to 0. Z-index: outgoing=1, strips=10-20 (staggered), incoming=5.

prompts.prompt: Design a paint reveal eraser transition that simulates someone erasing paint to reveal the video underneath, like cleaning a painted window. The eraser should move in smooth, curved strokes across the screen, with each stroke removing more of the paint layer. Create 3-4 eraser paths that intersect and overlap, with visible brush marks and varying pressure (opacity). The paint layer should have realistic texture with some areas thicker than others. As the paint is erased, add subtle smudge effects at the edges where the paint has been partially removed. Include particle effects of paint dust being wiped away.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2s overlap and 'relative w-full h-full bg-black' container. Create a full-screen paint layer div with 'absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-800 to-gray-600' and noise texture using CSS background-image with encoded SVG pattern. Incoming VideoAtom at z-index 1, paint layer at z-index 10. Create 4 eraser stroke divs using SVG path masks with stroke-width: 60px, animated with stroke-dashoffset from path length to 0. Each path has unique cubic-bezier curves for organic movement. Apply filter: blur(2px) to path edges for smudging. Create 20 particle divs that animate from eraser path points outward with gravity physics (translateY acceleration). Use mask-composite: exclude to remove paint where paths intersect. Add opacity animation on paint layer from 1 to 0.2 during final 500ms.
